entries.title: code-explorer
entries.summary: Fast read-only exploration: locate code, trace flows, map dependencies
entries.rationale: A universal read-only explorer every project benefits from; keeps search off the main thread

entries.title: go-builder
entries.summary: Implements Go changes (write code, vet, test -race, draft PR) with a human gate before merge
entries.rationale: A builder that owns a Go change end-to-end under a human gate, where write/vet/test add real value

entries.title: go-reviewer
entries.summary: Specialist review pass for Go changes (errors, concurrency, context, idioms)
entries.rationale: Per-stack reviewers are the canonical appliesWhen fit (ADR-019); only useful where Go exists

entries.title: python-builder
entries.summary: Implements Python changes (write code, ruff, mypy, pytest, draft PR) with a human gate before merge
entries.rationale: A builder that owns a Python change end-to-end under a human gate, where write/lint/test add real value

entries.title: python-reviewer
entries.summary: Specialist review pass for Python changes (typing, exceptions, packaging, idioms)
entries.rationale: Per-stack reviewers are the canonical appliesWhen fit (ADR-019); only useful where Python exists

entries.title: terraform-builder
entries.summary: Implements Terraform changes (write HCL, plan, draft PR) with a human gate before any apply
entries.rationale: A builder that owns the IaC change end-to-end under a human gate, where write/plan add real value

entries.title: terraform-reviewer
entries.summary: Specialist review pass for Terraform changes (state safety, replaces/destroys, IAM, secrets)
entries.rationale: Per-stack reviewers are the canonical appliesWhen fit (ADR-019); only useful where Terraform exists

entries.title: typescript-builder
entries.summary: Implements TypeScript changes (write code, typecheck, lint, test, draft PR) with a human gate before merge
entries.rationale: A builder that owns a TypeScript change end-to-end under a human gate, where write/typecheck/lint/test add real value

entries.title: typescript-reviewer
entries.summary: Specialist review pass for TS/JS changes (type safety, async, Node/web security)
entries.rationale: Per-stack reviewers are the canonical appliesWhen fit (ADR-019); only useful where TS/JS exists

entries.title: Atlassian (Jira / Confluence)
entries.summary: Atlassian remote MCP server. OAuth 2.1 on first use. (Old /v1/sse endpoint dies 2026-06-30.)
entries.rationale: Ticket and docs access for the work chain (ticket-create/clarify); broadly applicable

entries.title: Bitbucket (community)
entries.summary: Bitbucket Cloud MCP via community server (local stdio). Repos, branches, PRs, comments. Needs workspace + app-password credentials.
entries.rationale: Bitbucket is the workspace's git host, but no official remote MCP server exists; this community stdio server fills the gap. Experimental — opt-in, until an official server ships

entries.title: CircleCI
entries.summary: CircleCI official MCP server (local stdio). Builds, failure logs, flaky tests, pipeline status. Needs CIRCLECI_TOKEN.
entries.rationale: CI/CD context (build logs, flaky tests, pipeline status) for projects on CircleCI; official server, run locally via npx

entries.title: Datadog
entries.summary: Datadog MCP server (preview). OAuth; non-US1 sites replace the host (e.g. mcp.datadoghq.eu). Covers backend telemetry (APM/logs/metrics) and frontend RUM/browser.
entries.rationale: Observability access for runnable services, pipelines, and frontend apps — backend (APM/logs/metrics) and client-side (RUM/browser) telemetry alike

entries.title: GitHub
entries.summary: GitHub remote MCP server (repos, PRs, issues, actions). OAuth on first use.
entries.rationale: Repo/PR/issue access from the agent; useful on almost any project under git

entries.title: Slack
entries.summary: Slack official remote MCP server. Search messages/channels/users, read threads, send messages, canvases. OAuth on first use.
entries.rationale: Team-communication access (search, threads, post) for the work/incident chains; official hosted remote, useful on almost any team project

entries.title: Accessibility rules
entries.summary: Inclusive UI baseline — semantic markup, keyboard/focus, contrast, and target WCAG level
entries.rationale: Only meaningful for projects with a user-facing UI; gated to frontend workspaces

entries.title: API & contract rules
entries.summary: Backward-compatible interfaces, edge validation, stable error shapes for API producers/consumers
entries.rationale: Relevant to projects that expose or consume an API surface

entries.title: CI gates & enforcement rules
entries.summary: At least one automated check that fails the build on violation; never merge red, never disable a gate
entries.rationale: Enforcement baseline every project needs; universal

entries.title: Code style rules
entries.summary: Language-neutral baseline — type safety at boundaries, small focused functions, consistent naming
entries.rationale: Universal style floor; ai-init concretizes it per language

entries.title: Configuration & secrets rules
entries.summary: Env-driven config, startup validation, secrets never committed, rotation without a code change
entries.rationale: Relevant to anything with runtime configuration or secret material

entries.title: Context rules
entries.summary: How the AI reads and writes the append-only .context/ project memory (ADRs + AI log)
entries.rationale: Governs the context chain shipped in every install; universal

entries.title: Data privacy rules
entries.summary: Minimize and retain deliberately, protect PII in transit and at rest, never log it, honor consent
entries.rationale: Relevant to projects that handle personal or sensitive data

entries.title: Dependency & supply-chain rules
entries.summary: Justify and vet every dependency, pin deliberately, keep the lockfile honest, remove dead deps
entries.rationale: Supply-chain hygiene applies to every project; universal

entries.title: Dependency scan
entries.summary: A dependency/SCA scan is a pre-PR gate on changed manifests; findings become tracked tickets, not silent fixes
entries.rationale: Universal wherever dependencies live; SCA is a routine pre-merge gate, not an afterthought

entries.title: Documentation rules
entries.summary: Keep docs in sync with the change, document the non-obvious, record decisions as ADRs
entries.rationale: Documentation discipline applies to every project; universal

entries.title: Git workflow rules
entries.summary: Branch per change, conventional commits, small reviewable PRs, no force-push to shared branches
entries.rationale: Version-control discipline applies to every project; universal

entries.title: Internationalization (i18n) rules
entries.summary: Externalized strings, locale-aware formatting, no concatenated translations
entries.rationale: Only meaningful once a localization library is in use

entries.title: Incident response
entries.summary: On-call readiness — runbooks for critical paths, severity definitions, comms cadence, a practiced rollback; optional module for deployed runtimes
entries.rationale: On-call readiness only matters for deployed runtimes; optional — adopt when the system is on-call

entries.title: Messaging: async
entries.summary: Idempotent consumers, versioned schemas, dead-letter handling, correlation/trace propagation, bounded queues
entries.rationale: Async-messaging conventions the core rules can't carry generically; applies wherever a producer/consumer exists

entries.title: Multi-tenant
entries.summary: Tenant isolation is first-class — no shared-default cross-tenant leak, scope enforced everywhere, isolation tested as a gate
entries.rationale: Applies wherever more than one tenant shares a system; a shared-system isolation bug is every tenant's incident

entries.title: No-touch zones
entries.summary: Files that must not change without explicit human approval — secrets, lockfiles, generated, state
entries.rationale: Protected-zone safety baseline every project needs; universal

entries.title: Observability rules
entries.summary: Structured logs with correlation ids, metrics and tracing, honest health — no silent failures
entries.rationale: Relevant to software that runs and must be debuggable in production

entries.title: OpenAPI: contract
entries.summary: The OpenAPI spec is the source of truth — never drifts from the implementation, breaking changes are versioned, clients regenerated
entries.rationale: Specializes the generic api-contract rule for OpenAPI; applies wherever an OpenAPI spec exists

entries.title: Performance & scalability rules
entries.summary: Avoid N+1, paginate unbounded lists, parallelize independent I/O, respect explicit budgets
entries.rationale: Performance discipline applies to every project; ai-init sets real budgets

entries.title: Resilience & reliability rules
entries.summary: Timeouts on every external call, capped retries on idempotent ops only, honest degradation
entries.rationale: Relevant to software that crosses network or process boundaries

entries.title: Security rules
entries.summary: Secrets hygiene, input validation at trust boundaries, parameterized queries, safe error handling
entries.rationale: Transversal security baseline every project needs; universal (no appliesWhen)

entries.title: Stack: Go
entries.summary: Idiomatic Go — error handling, concurrency, layout cmd/pkg, context propagation
entries.rationale: Go-specific conventions the core rules can't carry generically; applies wherever Go exists

entries.title: Stack: Next.js
entries.summary: Next.js conventions and pitfalls: server/client boundaries, caching, hydration, env exposure
entries.rationale: Next.js-specific conventions the core rules can't carry generically

entries.title: Stack: Node + Express
entries.summary: Express service conventions: one error middleware, edge validation, middleware order, graceful shutdown, event-loop discipline
entries.rationale: Express-specific conventions the core rules can't carry generically

entries.title: Stack: Python
entries.summary: Idiomatic Python — packaging, explicit typing, dependency hygiene, dependency injection at boundaries
entries.rationale: Python-specific conventions the core rules can't carry generically; applies wherever Python exists

entries.title: Stack: Terraform
entries.summary: HCL conventions, least-privilege IAM, state safety, and plan-before-apply discipline for IaC
entries.rationale: Terraform-specific conventions the core rules can't carry generically; applies wherever HCL exists

entries.title: Test strategy rules
entries.summary: TDD by default, a test pyramid, mock only true boundaries, coverage is a floor on changed code
entries.rationale: Testing discipline applies to every project; universal

entries.title: adr-write
entries.summary: Record a significant technical decision as a complete ADR and refresh the index
entries.rationale: Decision-capture step of the context chain; universal

entries.title: ai-init
entries.summary: Analyze a real codebase and concretize the generic scaffold into project-specific context
entries.rationale: The keystone bootstrap skill every project runs once; universal

entries.title: ai-log-write
entries.summary: Append an AI session log entry after committed code, with context for future sessions
entries.rationale: Session-memory step of the context chain; universal

entries.title: context-update
entries.summary: Regenerate .context/INDEX.md from sources and surface pending rule updates
entries.rationale: Index-maintenance step of the context chain; universal

entries.title: debug
entries.summary: Find a bug's root cause with evidence before proposing any fix
entries.rationale: Root-cause discipline applies to any project; universal

entries.title: e2e-test-gen
entries.summary: Generate E2E tests for a critical user flow (happy path + failure modes), stable and anti-flake
entries.rationale: E2E authoring for the critical flows only useful where there is a runnable user-facing surface; complements unit test-gen, doesn't replace it

entries.title: incident
entries.summary: Mitigate a production incident first, then hotfix (post-deploy chain entry → postmortem-write → prevent-tickets)
entries.rationale: Production incident response, only relevant for deployed runtimes; entry of the post-deploy learning chain

entries.title: migration
entries.summary: Safe expand-contract DB/data migrations with a rollback path
entries.rationale: DB migration discipline, only relevant when the project has a database

entries.title: new-endpoint
entries.summary: Scaffold a new HTTP endpoint following the project's existing pattern
entries.rationale: Endpoint scaffolding, only relevant where there is an HTTP surface

entries.title: obs-audit
entries.summary: Read-only audit of observability coverage (gaps in logs/metrics/traces, silent failures, PII) → findings via ticket-from-finding
entries.rationale: Audit op of the observability chain; activates the observability rule into a concrete coverage check, only for runtimes

entries.title: obs-instrument
entries.summary: Add missing observability (structured logs, correlation ids, page-on metrics, trace propagation, error reporting) for a path
entries.rationale: Implement op of the observability chain; closes the gaps that obs-audit finds, per the observability rule

entries.title: openapi
entries.summary: Keep OpenAPI the source of truth (generate/validate/drift-check/regenerate clients), gated by the openapi-contract rule
entries.rationale: Runs the openapi-contract rule into practice; only useful where an OpenAPI spec exists or is being introduced

entries.title: perf-budget
entries.summary: Set/record/enforce explicit perf budgets (latency, query count, bundle) so regressions are conscious, not silent
entries.rationale: Budget op of the performance chain; makes the performance rule's "respect budgets" clause concrete and enforceable

entries.title: perf-investigate
entries.summary: Investigate a perf regression/complaint — reproduce, profile, isolate root cause, quantify, hand off the fix
entries.rationale: Investigate op of the performance chain; activates the performance rule into a reproducible method, only for runtimes

entries.title: postmortem-write
entries.summary: Author a blameless postmortem from an incident (timeline, root cause, contributing factors, prevention), gate before publishing
entries.rationale: Post-deploy chain authoring op; separates postmortem authoring from the heat of incident response, only relevant for deployed runtimes

entries.title: pr-review
entries.summary: Review a diff in seven structured passes with actionable findings
entries.rationale: Final review step of the work chain; universal

entries.title: pr-write
entries.summary: Generate a conventional-commits PR description from the diff and brief
entries.rationale: PR-authoring step of the work chain; universal

entries.title: prevent-tickets
entries.summary: Turn prevention actions from an incident/postmortem into a batch of tracked tickets (closing the learning loop)
entries.rationale: The loop-closing op of the post-deploy chain; batch-extracts systemic prevention actions into tracked work so incidents don't recur silently

entries.title: refactor
entries.summary: Improve structure without changing behavior, tests-first
entries.rationale: Behavior-preserving refactoring applies to any project; universal

entries.title: review
entries.summary: Quick review of a diff for rule violations, edge cases, security and tests
entries.rationale: Lightweight self-review applies to any change; universal

entries.title: security-review
entries.summary: Threat-model-style security pass — authz, injection, SSRF, secrets, crypto
entries.rationale: Security review applies to every project; universal

entries.title: snyk-scan
entries.summary: Run Snyk, triage findings, remediate at the gate, convert real hits into tracked tickets
entries.rationale: The run-and-remediate op of the security chain; activates the dependency-scan rule into actual practice

entries.title: task-implement
entries.summary: Execute an approved plan test-first (TDD), without silent deviation
entries.rationale: Implementation step of the work chain; universal

entries.title: task-plan
entries.summary: Produce a file-level technical plan from an approved brief
entries.rationale: Planning step of the work chain; universal

entries.title: tenant-build
entries.summary: Onboard a new tenant end-to-end (config, isolation, provisioning, verify) under the multi-tenant rule
entries.rationale: Provisioning op of the multi-tenant chain; runs the multi-tenant rule into the concrete act of standing up a tenant safely

entries.title: terraform-plan
entries.summary: Run terraform fmt/validate/plan safely and report the plan for human review
entries.rationale: IaC changes need a reviewed plan; only relevant where Terraform exists

entries.title: test-gen
entries.summary: Write tests for a function or module following the project's test conventions
entries.rationale: Test authoring applies to any project; universal

entries.title: ticket-clarify
entries.summary: Turn any input into a structured technical brief, marking gaps
entries.rationale: Clarification step of the work chain; universal

entries.title: ticket-create
entries.summary: Author a complete ticket from a rough idea by asking the right questions first
entries.rationale: Ticket-authoring entry of the work chain; universal

entries.title: ticket-from-finding
entries.summary: Convert a structured finding into a remediation ticket (map fields, preserve severity & evidence, gate before filing)
entries.rationale: Structured bridge from the perf/security/observability chains into the work chain; findings carry severity+evidence that must survive into the ticket

entries.title: ticket-from-report
entries.summary: Convert a report into a complete ticket (extract, mark gaps, ask minimally, gate before filing)
entries.rationale: Bridges ad-hoc/external reports into the work chain; universal entry for unstructured input that already describes a problem

entries.title: ticket-refine
entries.summary: Refine an existing ticket in place (sharpen, fill, split), with asks and a gate before filing
entries.rationale: Maintenance op on the work chain; rescues stale/vague/too-big tickets so they can re-enter planning

entries.title: ticket-update
entries.summary: Reflect real work progress back onto an existing ticket (status + evidence), with a gate before filing
entries.rationale: The close-the-loop reflection op of the work chain; only useful where a ticket/tracker context exists

entries.title: verify
entries.summary: Run build, tests, lint, coverage and audit to prove a change before a PR
entries.rationale: Verification gate of the work chain; universal
